title: Evolution of the subsurface salinity core
query:
Track the subsurface salinity core of a Loop Current eddy through its resolved lifetime. Determine whether its salinity maximum weakens, strengthens, or remains stable, and assess how the evolution relates to mixed-layer deepening and changes in eddy position.

Independently identify relevant literature and appropriate methods. Deliver an evidence-based report, supporting figures, and one executable analysis notebook. Distinguish demonstrated results from mechanisms that the supplied data cannot establish.
